description: This file implements JSON handling classes and functions, including error message formatting, static tag definitions, and debug string generation for variants and variant containers within the WPEFramework Core JSON namespace.

classes.name: IElement
classes.description: Contains static character tags for JSON elements (null, true, false).

classes.name: Variant
classes.description: Represents a JSON variant with type and value, providing debug string output.

classes.name: VariantContainer
classes.description: Container for multiple Variants, providing debug string output.

methods.name: ErrorDisplayMessage
methods.description: Formats an error message with context and position.

methods.name: Variant::GetDebugString
methods.description: Returns a formatted debug string representing the Variant's contents.

methods.name: VariantContainer::GetDebugString
methods.description: Returns a formatted debug string for all Variants in the container.
